- [Toggl Track API](https://www.hotbot.com/articles/maximize-your-productivity-an-in-depth-toggl-track-user-guide/) - A RESTful JSON API for Toggl’s time tracking service, enabling developers and third‑party applications to programmatically manage users, projects, and time entries in Toggl Track.
